# Providers

<!-- Generated by scraper/scripts/gen-providers-doc.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

23 providers. The **id** column is what you pass to `?providers=`,
and an unknown id is rejected with a 400 that lists the known ones.
A host can switch any of them off with `SCRAPER_DISABLED_PROVIDERS`,
which is reported separately from an unknown id.

**mirrors** is how many domains the provider rotates through when one is
blocked or down. A dash means it has a single fixed host.

## Ids that do not match their filename

The id is the site's name, the module is named for its implementation, and
these two disagree. Pass the **id**, never the filename:

- `leetx.js` registers as **`1337x`**, not `leetx`.

## Adding one

Copy `scraper/providers/_template.js`, then register the module in
`scraper/providers/index.js` and add the id to `TorrentProvider` in
`addon/lib/types.js` plus a `PublicProviderAliases` entry in
`addon/lib/configuration.js`, or it will not be selectable. Declare `types`
to match what `scrape()` actually serves. `scraper/test/provider-contract.test.js`
checks all of that. Regenerate this file with `npm run doc:providers`.
